solutionSql:
SELECT id, tracking_code
FROM shipments
WHERE RIGHT(tracking_code, 4) BETWEEN '0010' AND '0019'
ORDER BY id ASC;

ambiguities.phrase: Return id and tracking_code for shipments whose tracking code ends in 0010 through 0019.
ambiguities.readingChosen: The last four characters are compared as text, so 0010 to 0019 is a string range.
ambiguities.alternativeReading: The four-digit serial is read as a number and checked to be from 10 to 19.

notes: Every tracking code has a fixed-width four-digit serial, so the text and numeric readings return the same rows here. Ids 10 to 19 are the result.
